🍕 FOOD RUSH DELIVERY SIMULATOR 🍔
Become the fastest food delivery driver in the city!

📱 Pick orders on your phone, drive to the restaurant, grab the food and race it to hungry customers. Ring the doorbell, hand it over and earn big tips for fast deliveries!

🚗 FEATURES
• 10 cars to unlock, from the Zippy Hatch to the Milan Hyper
• Upgrade your engine, turbo, tires and hot bag
• Pizza, burgers, tacos, donuts, sushi, noodles, ice cream and more
• Walk-in restaurants, food trucks and customers waving you down on the street
• A huge city with downtown towers, suburbs, a beach, farms and a freeway
• LUNCH RUSH every few minutes: 1.5x cash for everyone!
• Hire drivers who earn cash for you, even while you're offline
• Daily rewards, daily quests and free gifts

🎁 CODES
FOODRUSH • YUMMY • PIZZA

👍 Like and favorite for more updates!
